public_api_budget_note: The frozen design requires four search calls plus at most two detail calls per unique candidate; authenticated access is attempted first and public unauthenticated fallback is allowed without changing the source set.
selection_rule: Take the first max_items_per_repository search results in each frozen repo/stratum after created-ascending sort, deduplicate by repository and PR number preserving terminal_unmerged priority, then apply eligibility without replacement or source expansion.

strata.name: terminal_unmerged
strata.query_template: repo:{repo} is:pr is:closed is:unmerged closed:2025-01-01..2025-12-31 review:approved
